metadata.case_name: CHU KA WAI v. HOP HING FURNITURE CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: delivery worker / transportation (delivery worker, operated own lorry)
plaintiff.occupation_after: employee of Ying Fat until May 2015; from June 2015 onwards worked as a forklift operator

injuries.description: Computed tomography of his brain showed acute right epidural haemorrhage with compression and effacement of ipsilateral lateral and third ventricles, and midline shift to the left.
source: Computed tomography of his brain showed acute right epidural haemorrhage with compression and effacement of ipsilateral lateral and third ventricles, and midline shift to the left.

injuries.description: He also suffered right temporal bone fracture.
source: He also suffered right temporal bone fracture.
injuries.icd_description: Other fractures of base of skull

injuries.description: X-ray of his right elbow revealed right olecranon fracture.
source: X-ray of his right elbow revealed right olecranon fracture.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of ulna

manifestations.description: loss of consciousness and seizure for one minute
mild residual post-concussional syndrome which is permanent in nature
difficulty in concentration on and performance of certain mental tasks
residual pain, stiffness and weakness over his right elbow
dizziness aggravated by big movement especially extension and weather changes

treatments_received: treatment from the Department of Neurosurgery
treatment from the Department of Orthopaedics & Traumatology
physiotherapy (completed 22 sessions of out-patient physiotherapy in Tuen Mun Hospital)
treatments_future: periodic clinic visits for headaches and dizziness (4 visits annually at HK$400 each)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to pursue pre-accident hobbies including boxing, basketball and snooker due to his residual pain.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty in performing repair and handyman jobs at home and shared household work due to his medical condition after the accident.
Difficulty in concentration, alleged memory impairment and related post-concussional symptoms.
